correctness.rationale: For profiles in Z>=0^7 of weight 4, one unordered deletion is correctable iff L1 distance at least 4. Classify profile multiplicities as 1111/211/22/31/4 with respective counts x,y,z,a,b. Triple packing plus degree convexity rules out x=8, so x<=7; high coordinate uniqueness gives a+b<=7; 42 ordered arcs used at rates 2,2,1 for 211,22,31 imply 2y+2z+a<=42. Hence |C|<=35. Equality forces x=7,a=0,b=7,y+z=21 and all arcs used. Complements of seven compatible 4-subsets form an STS(7); any feasible 211 support meets every line, hence itself a Fano line. Omitting any 22 pair forces reverse 211 words on its unique line, violating distance. Thus y=0,z=21 and every maximizer has common even core 28 plus seven Fano complements. STS(7) has |Aut|=168, giving 7!/168=30 labeled codes. Independent exact cover enumerated 30 systems and checked every code distance.
